Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1258 PM EST Tue Nov 24 2026
 

- Dry and seasonable conditions Wednesday.

- Widespread rain develops Thanksgiving and continues through Friday.
  Potential for rain to mix with snow at times Friday morning.
 
- Additional precipitation chances possible over the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

VFR conditions prevail at the beginning of the 18Z TAF cycle as multi-
layer ridging occupies the airspace through this evening. Surface 
high pressure center tracks eastward across Lower Michigan during 
the next 12 hours, flipping winds northeasterly tonight, before 
settling from the east closer to daybreak Wednesday. Expect some 
degree of lake flux to introduce moisture into the 3-4 kft AGL layer 
late tonight. Expanded a period of high-end MVFR to all terminals, 
but confidence in reaching the BKN coverage threshold is medium, at 
best. Otherwise, the diurnal response should lift and scatter out 
any existing stratocumulus cloud by mid morning, with VFR expected 
into Wednesday afternoon. Notable uptick in wind speeds Wednesday, 
sustained above 10 knots, as the pressure field responds to an 
expansive low lifting along the Atlantic coast.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Medium for ceilings at or below 5000 feet from 08-13Z Wednesday.
